text: 市场监管总局（国家认监委）对电动汽车供电设备强制性产品认证（CCC认证）管理8月1日起强制实施，通过开展防触电、短路保护、耐火耐燃等关键安全指标测试和企业现场质量保证能力、产品一致性检查，切实筑牢产品质量安全底线。随着我国新能源汽车的不断普及和发展，电动汽车供电设备（俗称充电桩）已经成为服务百姓出行需求的重要基础设施。8月1日起，未获得CCC认证的电动汽车供电设备，不得出厂、销售、进口或者在其他经营活动中使用。对于8月1日前已经投入运营的设备，经营者应当严格遵守《中华人民共和国产品质量法》《中华人民共和国消费者权益保护法》有关规定，保证其提供的商品或者服
text_en: From August 1, the State Administration for Market Regulation (CNCA) will mandatorily enforce CCC certification management for electric vehicle power supply equipment, conducting tests on key safety indicators such as electric shock protection, short-circuit protection, and fire/heat resistance, along with on-site inspections of manufacturing quality assurance capability and product consistency to firmly safeguard product quality and safety standards. As new energy vehicles become increasingly widespread, EV power supply equipment (commonly known as charging piles) has become vital infrastructure for public travel. Starting August 1, EV power supply equipment without CCC certification may not be shipped, sold, imported, or used in other business operations. For equipment already in operation before August 1, operators must strictly comply with the Product Quality Law and Consumer Rights Protection Law to ensure the goods or services they provide meet regulations.
